proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly separates the hungry adjective *bubhukṣaka from the hunger noun bubhukṣā and the hungry participle bubhukṣita. Its documented comparanda include Awankari bhukhā, Hindi bhūkhā, Old Marwari bhūkhaü and Nepali bhoko. These simple -ā/-o adjective responses fit that family; suffixed clauses and compounds are excluded.
